description:
Connie Wood | 512.540.2615



9206 Susan Drive, Killeen, TX

Map it at https://www.google.com/maps/place/9206+Susan+Drive,+Killeen,+TX

https://www.homeatanywhere.com/9206-Susan-Drive-KILLEEN-TX-76542/index.html

Coldwell Banker

ColdwellBankerHomes.com

Move-in ready three-bed, two-bath in Splawn Ranch — freshly painted and professionally cleaned. Roof replaced May 2025. Bright, open living areas with a functional floor plan that flows from the kitchen to the dining and living spaces, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features granite countertops, a center island, a walk-in pantry, and a stainless-steel appliance package. Carpet in the bedrooms and tile throughout the rest of the home. Full-yard automatic sprinkler system. The owner’s retreat is tucked toward the rear for privacy, offers abundant natural light, and includes an en-suite with a double vanity, a walk-in closet, and a large walk-in shower. The spacious backyard provides room for outdoor activities and a blank canvas to create your own oasis. Conveniently located near the front of the subdivision with easy access to Hwy 195 for a quick commute to Austin and Fort Hood, yet tucked away from the hustle and bustle of city life. Great option for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors seeking a clean, well-kept property in a desirable location. Room dimensions are approximate; buyer should verify. Call for a private showing.
